correctness.rationale: The local 2-adic binomial lemma was rederived term by term; the mod-16 prime-power cases and Jacobi-symbol reduction were checked, and exact bounded computation found zero mismatches in 500,000 (n,r) tests.

originality.rationale: OEIS records the odd RMS residue pattern as an empirical observation and the sigma-r definition, but the inspected sources and synonymous searches did not reveal the proof or the general 2-adic congruence. The empirical observation itself is not claimed as new; originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result proves a longstanding recorded RMS residue pattern and replaces it with a uniform congruence theorem for all odd n and all even r, including a generalized perfect-power obstruction.
